lines: #You'd never miss a meeting with your *boss.*
#But the promise you made to go to the *gym?*
To start *saving?* To finally begin that project?
Those you cancel without a second *thought.*
And every broken promise teaches you that your plans don't *matter.*
Your own *word* starts to mean nothing.
You make plans, and part of you already *knows* you won't.
#Start treating appointments with yourself like *real* appointments.
Don't cancel unless it's a real *emergency.*
If it matters to you, it *matters.*
#You deserve the same respect you give *everyone* else.
end: Follow for your daily push at 7am & 7pm.

post.title: You Keep Your Word to Everyone Except Yourself
post.caption: Treat appointments with yourself like real appointments. 📅
post.first_comment: What promise to yourself will you keep today? 👇
